content.comment_body: Hello, Will [product_name] be able to handle this sensor without any issues? [url] I want to use this to count items passing on a conveyor belt. I already have the [product_name], but need the sensor. Some of the items are transparent, so I chose this sensor. Thank you for your help.
If your [product_name] has 24 VDC inputs, there shouldn't be any compatibility problems.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wishes to connect an external compact photoelectric sensor to a [product_name] module for automated counting, including transparent objects. The main point is verifying compatibility of the [product_name] with sensors that operate at 24 VDC. The response indicates that as long as the [product_name] supports 24 VDC inputs, sensor integration should be straightforward.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates simple and reliable connection of the selected sensor to the [product_name] system, expecting confirmation that it will function smoothly with 24 VDC inputs.
